text:
sam: starting thread for Meridian presales. they expect short marketing bursts ~820 rps for 8-12m, baseline ~260 rps. question: what's the pragmatic mix of reserved GPUs + burst credits and safe autoscale settings?

leila: couple of clarifying Qs: avg token length? percentage chat vs embeddings? strict tail latency requirements?

sam: median ~170 tokens, 75% chat, 25% embedding lookups. target p95 < 850ms, p50 ~180ms. prefer a quantized 13B for cost but want a fallback.

ben: quick back-of-envelope: bursts length means we should avoid relying solely on autoscale cold ramps. propose sizing reserved for steady baseline + small headroom and a convertable burst pool for promo windows. propose reserved 5 GPUs steady, burst credits sized to cover +560 rps for up to 15m.

leila: operational notes: - prewarm KV cache per-shard 10m before window - use synthetic prefix hits to populate common caches - implement queue hysteresis so autoscaler doesn't oscillate on short spikes - set edge 429 with Retry-After for overflow.

ops-bot: autoscale suggestion to include in runbook: {"min_replicas":"4","max_replicas":"16","scale_metric":"rps","target_rps_per_replica":"70","ramp_cooldown_s":"25"}

ben: routing policy: default->quant13. If queue_depth > 50 or p95 rises above 900ms for 45s, start shifting 20% traffic to fp16 70B until metrics recover. also set a hard cap on continuous burst usage (20m) to avoid runaway costs.

leila: edge guidance for client SDK: exponential backoff with jitter, max 3 retries, treat 429 as soft-fail with Retry-After header; for non-critical embedding requests return cached vector if available.

pricing: Meridian asked for a 12mo reserved quote + burst addon and delta vs pure on-demand. pricing: please pull SKU numbers; ballpark reserved reduces per-token by ~20% for quantized models.

sec-bot: security flag: Meridian requires customer-managed KMS, monthly audit export, and option for VPC peering for Private. note: Dedicated/Private support KMS; Hosted supports envelope encryption + audit export. include KMS diagram in appendix.

ben: preflight POC plan: 1) synthetic promo sim for 30m 2) KV warmup 10m before run 3) validate autoscale ramp and hysteresis behavior 4) failover test to fallback model 5) verify KMS + audit export flow. recommend a 2-hour slot.

sam: action items: ops to draft runbook + preheat script, security to prepare KMS appendix, pricing to provide 12mo quote. i'll schedule 30-min preflight call with Meridian ops tomorrow.

leila: example KV preheat loop for runbook: ```bash
for i in $(seq 1 1200); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/preheat -d '{"prefix":"meridian-promo","hits":1}' & done
```

ben: final proposal summary to send Meridian: reserved 5 GPUs baseline, burst credits for +560 rps (15m windows), autoscale min4/max16 (fast ramp, hysteresis), KV preheat, routing fallback to 70B fp16, edge 429 policy, security appendix (KMS+audit). draft by EOD. :thumbsup:
